{{Top}} {{Update|{{BuildXWingCite|24|Starfighter Aces}}}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:CR978_body.png]] |name=CR978 |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[3 ABY]], [[Hoth]] [[Hoth asteroid field|asteroid belt]]{{Film|V}} |species=[[Human]]''[[Lost Stars]]'' |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Death Squadron]] **[[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|C-R-Nine-Seven-Eight, pull up—pull up!|Ciena Ree tries to prevent CR978 from crashing|}} '''CR978''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Hoth]], CR978 was sent with three other [[pilot]]s to capture the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' after it fled into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]]. Imperial [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ciena Ree]] provided support for the four pilots from on board the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]'', but even with her aid CR978 crashed his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] into an [[asteroid]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Well done today, Lieutenant Commander."
"But— I lost all four pilots, sir."
"They had no chance, really. You kept them alive longer than they could have made it on their own.|Piett praises Ree for aiding CR978 and the other pilots|}} [[File:CR978TIEFighter-TESB.png|thumb|left|175px|CR978 flew a TIE fighter for the Empire.]] The [[human]] [[Gender|male]] designated as CR978 served in the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationed on board one of six [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], that traveled to the [[Hoth system]] in order to [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] [[Echo Base]], a Rebel base located on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The Alliance was forced to flee from the Empire's superior forces on the surface of Hoth, but the Imperial [[fleet]] was unable to prevent the Rebel [[transport]]s from escaping due to protection provided by an [[V-150 Planet Defender|ion cannon]] on Hoth. Following the Empire's victory, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] demanded that at least three of the six ''Imperial''-class [[Star Destroyer]]s, chase and capture the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] named the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' specifically. With the three Destroyers in pursuit the ''Falcon'' fled into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]], which was located in the Hoth [[Star system|system]], in the hopes of shaking them off by hiding. Unable to give effective pursuit itself, the Star Destroyer that CR978 was stationed on board deployed him and three other TIE [[pilot]]s–[[JA189|JA-189]], [[OL701|OL-701]], and [[Penrie|NA-811]]{{BuildXWingCite|24|Starfighter Aces}}–in [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s. Entering such a [[Asteroid field|belt]] in an unshielded [[Starship|craft]] was practically a [[Death|suicide]] mission for the four pilots, and [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ciena Ree]] was assigned to provide auxiliary [[Navigator|navigational]] assistance to CR978 and his comrades from on board the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of Vader's personal [[flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]''. As the four [[TIE series|TIEs]] chased the ''Falcon'' through the [[asteroid]]s, Ree warned CR978 that he needed to pull his craft up to avoid collision with an asteroid, but the pilot was too slow and his vessel exploded upon impact, hurling his body into [[Realspace|space]] and killing him. ===Legacy=== CR978's three comrades, [[JA189]], [[OL701]], and [[Penrie|NA811]] all eventually crashed as well, allowing the ''Falcon'' to hide and eventually escape the Imperials entirely. Disheartened by the deaths of the four pilots, Ree was surprised when she was complimented on her work by the commanding [[officer]] of the ''Executor'', [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]]. Since the Admiral had assumed the pilots had never stood a chance anyway, he was impressed that Ree had managed to keep them alive longer than they would have survived on their own. ==Behind the scenes== CR978 first appeared in the original release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] in [[1980]], and is the only TIE pilot to actually do so.
